// Planted positive control for TestOneCapturePipeHelper: a capture helper that opens
// its own pipe and reads it only after fn returns. The guard must flag this file.
func captureLate(fn func()) string {
	r, w, _ := os.Pipe()
	old := os.Stdout
	os.Stdout = w
	fn()
	os.Stdout = old
	w.Close()
	b, _ := io.ReadAll(r)
	return string(b)
}
